description.value: Grand Chinese Langley is a Sichuan-focused Chinese restaurant in Langley, BC, serving an extensive menu of spicy, traditional dishes including signature boiled fish in chilli broth and Szechuan-style preparations. The 蜀莊 (Shu Zhuang) branding signals an emphasis on bold Sichuan flavours, with a wide selection of seafood, chicken, beef, and lamb dishes. A touring cyclist looking for a hearty sit-down meal in the Langley area would find a full-service dining experience here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the address (7280 200 St, Langley, BC V2Y1S7) and phone (+1 604-510-8880), matching OSM. The menu page legend explicitly lists 'vegetarian' as a category, confirming vegetarian options. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities, so those are null. The website is active (copyright 2026, December 2025 review), online ordering is temporarily disabled but the restaurant instructs customers to call or visit in store, confirming it is open. The OSM name includes 'Restaurant' while the website brands itself as 'Grand Chinese Langley' — a minor discrepancy flagged in concerns.
concerns: OSM name includes 'Restaurant' ("Grand Chinese Restaurant Langley") but the website consistently brands itself as 'Grand Chinese Langley' — the word 'Restaurant' does not appear in the site's own name.
OSM website URL contains a double trailing slash (https://grandchineselangley.com//); corrected to single slash in output.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Chinese restaurant with confirmed address, active website, and recent customer review. A valid dining stop for touring cyclists in Langley.
